programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Shayne Smith
programme.desc: Former Gang Member, current comedian, future famous comedian. Shayne Smith is the runner up in the Wiseguys' 2015 Funniest Person In Utah competition, winner of the 2015 Salt City Comedy Superstar contest and most recently voted best Alternative Comedian of 2016 by City Weekly.

programme.title: Brian Moote
programme.desc: Brian Moote started performing stand up in 2005 while he was working as a teacher in the Seattle School District. He then went to graduate school to get a masters degree in social work because who doesn't love crippling debt? I mean, this is America. After graduating he moved to LA and now tours the country telling jokes. He has made TV appearances on the USA Network's "Characters Welcome," Nickelodeon's "Nickmom's Nite Out," MTV's "Money from Strangers" and AXS TV's "Gotham Live." You should come out and see him tell jokes... DO IT!!!

programme.title: Matt Knudsen
programme.desc: Matt Knudsen was born in Hawaii, raised in the Mid-west and sailed around the world as a merchant marine. As an actor, Matt shared the big screen with Oscar winner Sean Penn in Gangster Squad, or you may also recognize him from his appearances in shows like Crazy Ex-Girlfriend, Key & Peele, Workaholics, The League, Big Love, Boston Legal or Malcolm in the Middle just to name a few. Matt has also been a part of several high profile commercial campaigns for companies including: Apple, IBM, GE, Volkswagen, DirecTV, Pepsi and more which have aired during the Superbowl and The Olympics. As a comedian, he's appeared on Conan, The Late Late Show, Last Call, ASX Live and Comics Unleashed, as well as dozens of festivals, including: Montreal Just for Laughs (Best of the Fest), The San Francisco Sketchfest, Bridgetown, High Plains, Limestone and has even entertained at The White House for President and Mrs. Obama.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman is found dead in a ravine, and crucial evidence has been washed away by severe thunderstorms. Twice, the trail turns cold. Almost 20 years later, an old hat and a chip of stainless steel brings the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1999, Susan Fassett was gunned down as she left her church choir practice in Poughkeepsie, NY. After clearing her husband, police turned their attention to Fred Andros, with whom Susan had an affair.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Police get a clue about a couple who disappeared on Memorial Day weekend during an in-progress robbery. The evidence found solves a brutal crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A Modesto, California teenager goes missing. With no signs of struggle in her home, police suspect she has simply run away — until her naked, bruised body is discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Rachael Mullenix, 19, was convicted of stabbing her mother, Barbara Mullenix, in 2006. She allegedly packed her mother's bloodied corpse in a cardboard box before dumping it in California's Newport Bay.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Keep Your Enemies Close
programme.desc: Cleo seeks a new job as an assistant dolphin trainer at the Marine Park. Rikki fires Nate's band from playing at the cafe until she and Bella reach an understanding.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Cleo is forced to put Lewis' plans for romance on hold to restrain Kim's out-of-control love life. During this time, Don meets Samantha, a National Parks manager, and they start dating.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Big Ideas
programme.desc: Zane concocts a dirt bike race to publicize the café. When Rikki discovers it's a scam, she and Bella decide to teach him and Nate a lesson. Cleo and Lewis make a major discovery about mixing the waters in the Moon Pool.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Bella attempts to start a relationship with Will until she sees he's apparently got another girl. Lewis tests the magic Moon Pool water at school and attracts the attention of their Science teacher.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Happy Families
programme.desc: A problematic family beach picnic leads Don to end his relationship with Samantha, until Cleo encourages him to pursue it. Will's sister, Sophie, competes with Bella for a job at the café and sets her sights on Zane.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Kidnapped
programme.desc: Rikki and Bella hide out at Cleo's to protect themselves from a full moon water attack. However, Bella is kidnapped by a water tentacle and taken to Mako Island. Lewis tries to keep Will away from the island so the girls can rescue her.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programme.desc: Cleo defies Lewis' advice and experiments with the magic Moon Pool water. Using her powers, Rikki accidentally gets the water into Cleo's aquarium and all the girls have to rescue Cleo's fish Hector.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Revealed
programme.desc: Bella's warned to back off from Will as he's on the trail of the girls' mermaid secrets. She gets too close to him and he finally discovers she's a mermaid.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Just a Girl at Heart
programme.desc: Bella helps Will with his free-diving training but when she realises he's more interested in her as a mermaid than a girl, she's hurt. Rikki and Cleo have to improvise when the cafe's first corporate function is actually a children's party.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Crime and Punishment
programme.desc: Rikki receives counterfeit money at the café and is held captive by criminals on a boat. Bella and Cleo are forced to reveal the trio's secret to Will, so they can rescue Rikki together.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: To Have and to Hold Back
programme.desc: Kim attempts to derail Don and Samantha's wedding. Lewis receives an opportunity to study in America. Cleo realises she's got to let Lewis live his own life and let him go overseas.
programme.sub-title: To Have and to Hold Back

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Mermaid Magic
programme.desc: Will pushes himself too far when Zane challenges him to prove his skills as a free-diver. The girls discover a unique crystal in the rock from the Moon Pool.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Power Play
programme.desc: Sophie uses Bella's idea for a fundraising concert and presents it as her own to Rikki to gain publicity for the café. Cleo's caught in the crossfire with Kim when Samantha moves in and puts her stamp on the Sertori home.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: The Dark Side
programme.desc: Rikki's frustrated by the water attacks and goes to Mako Island on a full moon to confront the strange force in the Moon Pool. With Cleo and Bella delayed, Will pursues her and discovers she's been affected by the experience.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: A Magnetic Attraction
programme.desc: Cleo's introduced to Ryan, a young geophysicist who's working for Samantha. Rikki doesn't react well to Cleo consulting Ryan about the Mako rock and a fracture begins to appear in the trio.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Into the Light
programme.desc: Rikki fears Ryan's explorations on Mako Island will uncover their secrets but Cleo and Bella discount her concern. She almost goes too far trying to stop Ryan from discovering the crystals in the Moon Pool.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Breakaway
programme.desc: Will competes in the Free-Diving Championships but afterward chooses to break from the sport and shrug off Sophie's influence on his life. Rikki sees Sophie kissing Zane at the event and breaks off their relationship.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Queen for a Day
programme.desc: Zane installs Sophie as head of staff at the café. Bella develops a sneezing allergy that also accidentally triggers her powers. Sophie seizes on the problem and looks to fire Bella and the band.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: The Jewel Thief
programme.desc: The girls discover the Mako crystals contain immense energy and need to mount a rescue mission when Zane jealously steals one in an effort to gain Rikki's attention.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Mako Masters

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Beach Party

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Too Close for Comfort

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: A Date With Destiny
programme.desc: Cleo discovers a comet is causing fish to flee the waters around Mako Island. The girls find a way to restart the message in the Moon Pool and discover the comet will collide with earth.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water: Graduation
programme.desc: Sophie and Ryan damage the Moon Pool in their efforts to obtain the rare crystals. The girls improvise and use their own magic to prevent the impact of the comet and a planet wide catastrophe. Rikki, Cleo and Bella graduate with a surprise.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water

programme.desc: Annoying Miss Popularity, Miriam, is having a pool party and the girls want to go. But being around water is risky, especially when Zane tosses Cleo into the pool. Lewis is the only one around to help so he finds out their secret.

programme.desc: Rikki, Emma and Cleo discover that sea turtles are being captured by fishing nets. When Rikki and Emma attempt to rescue the turtles by cutting the nets, it causes the fisherman to think that there is a rogue shark roaming their ocean.

programme.title: H2O: Just Add Water
programme.desc: Emma decides that she is not going to have her annual sleepover party due to what has happened to them. But Rikki and Cleo try to convince her otherwise. Meanwhile, Lewis conducts experiments on the girls.

programme.title: Toda Mujer

La muerte de la Nona en Italia sacude a todos, mientras Katiuska y Hortensia conspiran con Benjamín para robar el testamento y asegurar la herencia. Manuela enfrenta insultos de su familia tras dar la noticia de la muerte. Entre tensiones familiares y revelaciones de secretos del pasado, los personajes lidian con el caos, el alcoholismo y la ambición por la fortuna.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de la Nona, el robo de su testamento desata conflictos. Benjamín y Katiuska destruyen el nuevo testamento, sin saber que fueron grabados. Mientras el Dr. Fossi intenta validar una copia no notariada, el Dr. Bruzual la impugna. Las tensiones familiares aumentan: Elizabeth decide confesar la verdad a su padre, Graciela cae en el alcoholismo y Ricardo, engañado por Misael, acusa a Manuela de manipular la herencia, lo que termina en una confrontación física.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo y Manuela se enfrentan mientras Misael los confronta por celos. Elizabeth revela que Benjamín es Néstor Cordido, noticia que sorprende a Katiuska. Hortensia acepta casarse con Benjamín en secreto, ignorando que él robó el testamento. Por otro lado, Alejandro es expulsado de la iglesia tras ser visto con Margot. Manuela auxilia a una enferma Celia, quien luego le confirma a Ricardo la verdadera identidad de Benjamín, desenmascarando sus engaños ante el bufete y la familia.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia expulsa a Ricardo tras sus ataques contra Manuela, quien revela que Katiuska es amante de este. Alejandro es echado de la iglesia por el padre al ser visto con Margot, revelándose luego que no es sacerdote. Mientras Hortensia se prepara para su boda con Benjamín, este es interceptado por Misael y Julio César. Finalmente, se confirma que Celia espera un varón, noticia que genera gran revuelo, mientras Elizabeth guarda luto por la Nona.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel León es un famoso presentador televisivo famoso por su vitalidad y buena presencia pero en uno de sus programas sufre un desmayo y entonces va al médico y este le dice que deberá hacer un tratamiento de diálisis o hacerse un trasplante. Gabriel le confiesa esta verdad a su manager y amigo Epicúreo y también le dice que el donante será uno de sus hijos que no conoce pero que sabe que existen porque cuando tenía 18 años fue donante de esperma y le encarga a Epicúreo que se ocupe de encontrar a esos hijos. Epicúreo se hace pasar por diferentes roles y consigue la información que Gabriel estaba buscando o al menos algo de ella.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel conoce a Magdalena. Ella es la encargada de sacarle las fotos para la campaña publicitaria. Es muy dulce y queda enganchado con ella. Epicúreo va a entrevistar a Valentina Pacheco, pero con una información errónea. Y ella empieza a pensar en la hija que tuvo y dio, mediante fecundación in Vitro. Julieta siente que está defraudando a sus padres, por trabajar en un periódico de chimentos. Angie (esposa de Gabriel) está muy enojada porque él apaga su teléfono y no consigue localizarlo. Magdalena invita a Sofía (su ginecóloga) a cenar a su casa para ver si existe la posibilidad de tener otro hijo. Agustín se enoja con Sofía (que es su amante). Ya que le había pedido que dijera que eso era imposible, sin embargo Sofía afirma lo contrario.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Brenda le cuenta a Gabriel la historia del niño. Pero él no quiere hacerse cargo. Magdalena muy enojada le regresa las flores a Gabriel a su oficina. Lilibel y Nayarí intentan buscar los papeles del donante de Deibis, pero no lo consiguen. Marilyn le cuenta todo lo que pasa a Angie. Está se enoja mucho y más cuando Magdalena devuelve las flores. Ana Belén le cuenta a Efraín sobre la visita de Valentina. Gabriel se queda muy mal cuando conoce la sala de hemodiálisis y niega su enfermedad. Angie especula de las relaciones de Gabriel, con todas las mujeres que se han presentado últimamente. Brenda la pasa muy mal. No sólo Gabriel se desentiende del asunto, sino que la echan del trabajo y de su departamento

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Sofía le revela a Magdalena el secreto que le tenía guardado: Agustín, su marido, es infértil, y por lo tanto, no es el padre de su hijo Rodrigo. Impactada por semejante noticia, Magdalena se pierde por las calles de la ciudad, totalmente desconsolada. Pero lo que no le revelaron, es que Agustín y Sofía, son amantes desde hace años. Angie, celosa de unas flores que recibió Gabriel, finalmente consigue que su novio acepte ir con ella al cocktail de la revista Ricos y Famosos esa misma noche. Pero al final, Gabriel la deja plantada porque va en busca de Magdalena luego de que la llamara y notara su tristeza. Angie entra en cólera por la desaparición de Gabriel y decide ir de todas formas al cocktail y emborracharse.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena le insiste a Sofía en saber quién es el padre de su hijo, pero Sofía le miente diciendo que no tiene forma de saberlo. Además, quiere aprovechar el distanciamiento que ahora hay entre Magdalena y Agustín para quedarse con él. Pero Agustín no quiere saber nada con Sofía, sino que sigue enamorado de Magdalena. En El Maratón de la Alegría, Gabriel busca deshacerse de la inesperada interrupción al aire de Brenda. Una vez estando juntos y a solas, Gabriel le remarca que él fue simplemente un donante y que no se hará cargo del chico, aunque se apiada de ella y la toma como nueva empleada de su empresa. Ana Belén y Efraín están mal en su relación. Ambos sienten que ya no hay pasión.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: El socio de Heriberto lo visita en la cárcel para confesarle que ahora se alió con Reina para secuestrar a Alejandro, ya que ella le pagará más.Reina lleva sedado a Alejandro a un hotel y lo hace pasar por parapléjico, pero cuando sale olvida su teléfono, y Alejandro aprovecha para llamar a Sol y contarle que lo tienen ahí, y también pedirle que llame a la policía. Luego Reina regresa antes que Alejandro escape, y se lo lleva junto a su nuevo socio en una camioneta.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto logra escapar de la cárcel y le pasa información a Maricielo sobre el posible escondite al que Reina irá con Alejandro. La policía consigue dar con los secuestradores y recuperar sano y salvo a Alejandro, pero Reina se da a la fuga. A último momento, es interceptada por las patrullas. Luego, Heriberto se dirige a la casa de Sol y le dice que ha ayudado a la policía para recuperar a Alejandro. Ella confía en él pero, al momento de brindar, Heriberto le pone una droga en su bebida.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Reina es apresada y luego la atropella un automóvil. Heriberto le escribe una carta a Sol y le hace creer que hicieron el amor. Víctor Hugo es apresado por Maricielo. Tras su arresto, Carlos le reprocha a Alicia el haber sido la responsable de la muerte de Ramón. José Domingo se entera de que puede ser el padre de Alicia y Alejandro. Eloy y Columba se reconcilian. Cristo José le dice a Bárbara que se va a divorciar pero también le comenta a Giselle que tampoco quiere estar con ella.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro logra confesarle a Sol que no son hermanos. Insegura por la situación vivida con Heriberto, Sol se hace estudios para tratar de determinar si tuvieron relaciones. Luego visita a Heriberto en la cárcel, donde él le confiesa que la drogó, pero que no le dio el coraje para abusar de ella. Alicia hace un acuerdo con Cristina para que ella figure como la donante en su trasplante de médula, pero al momento de la operación, Cristina no está. Alicia hace esfuerzos para que no logren sedarla.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol y Alejandro anuncian que se van a casar y también que Sol está embarazada. Reina le dice a Sol que Heriberto la violó y que el hijo que espera es de él. Sol recibe una prueba médica que verifica que lo que le dijo Reina es verdad. Heriberto es trasladado, para luego ser llevado a Texas, donde será ejecutado. Durante el trayecto, llama a Sol. Heriberto le repite que no la violó pero la llamada se corta. Alejandro le pregunta a Sol qué pasa y esta le dice que ya no podrán ser felices.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Wilker y Yubiri siguen besándose. Cada uno de ellos pensando en lo feliz que se sienten. El se despide de ella y quedan en no hablarse más. Carolina le forma un escándalo a Segundo por besarla pero piensa que le gusta más que los besos de Juan Diego. Se van del local. Atanasio sigue aconsejando a Juan Diego en lo que se refiere a las mujeres. Wilker anima a su mamá a que se consiga un novio para que la acompañe. Ella le dice que no | que lo que quieres es que se case y tenga bastantes nietos.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la agencia siguen con la repartición de regalos. Olegario y Junior están acompañando a Fabián que está sumamente triste por no estar pasándola con su Finita e hijas. En la agencia siguen con los regalos. Ana ya le regaló a Pastor y Pastor a Mauricio. Lolita y Dionisia quieren atender a ROKUro como un rey. El tiene pena. Carolina sigue pensando en el beso de Segundo y viendo la hora que es y Juan Diego no la llama. Juan Diego le regala a Yubiri y se abrazan.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Por fin se despiden en la agencia y todos se dan el feliz año Mauricio le dice a Pastor que el año que viene tendrá que ayudar a Ana en los arreglos del matrimonio. Briggite lleva a Wilker a un restaurante . Este cuando entra casi se muere pues no sabe de donde va a pagar Briggite viendo el nerviosismo de Wilker | le dice que ella va a pagar. El le dice que no | que un hombre no debe permitir eso. Juan Diego está almorzando en la casa de Yubiri. Todos los atienden como si fuer a un rey.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En casa de ROKUro todos están llorando por la emotividad de las palabras de ROKUro y Bienvenida. En la casa de Jesica y Junior están Pastor | Fabián y Olegario. También está el Doctor Caridad todos cenando. Se presenta Carolina a pedirle un favor a Junior. Yubiri y Mayerlin se quedaron en la casa | cuidándola mientras que los demás fueron a acompañar a ROKUro. Wilker le trae un dulce a Bienvenida. Entra a la casa y comienza a hablar con Yubiri y s e presenta Mayerlin..

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Ana casi se desmaya con la noticia de la tarjetas. Entra Pastor y las ve y también casi se desmaya. El único feliz con todo esto es Mauricio. Junior va a la bruja que le dijo Graciela. La bruja le dice que no busque más porque la mujer que está buscando está cerca | muy cerca de el. Wilker está preocupado por lo del CD ya que no confía en el productor. Yubiri lo ve y se sienta con él . El le cuenta su preocupación y ella lo anima. El la besa y le dice que su CD se lo va a dedicar a ella.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene y Leonardo vuelven del viaje y Felipe los espera ansioso. Alejandra se entera de que se filtró un correo donde piden a alguien para su puesto y confronta a Leonardo, quien la saca violentamente de su oficina. Rodrigo amenaza a Rebeca con revelar todo el plan si Adolfo y ella deciden traicionarlos. Además, le pregunta qué pasaría si se supiera que ella es la asesina de Miguel Ferrándiz. Anzola le declara su amor a Trinidad y esta lo rechaza. Jimena tiene una dura conversación con Carlos Ernesto en la cual él le pide que lo deje amar a Virginia. Luego, Jimena se enfrenta a Virginia y le confiesa que tiene dudas sobre la autoría del crimen. Virginia le dice que ama a Carlos Ernesto y que luchará con todo para limpiar su nombre.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto y Leonardo hablan acerca de las sospechas del segundo sobre la verdadera paternidad de Mateo, el hijo de Irene. Sin que ellos lo sepan, Rebeca los está escuchando. Virginia y Jimena se reconcilian y le comunican la buena nueva a Carlos Ernesto, quien se muestra feliz y agradecido. Leo es liberado de la cárcel y se reencuentra con su padre. En una molesta discusión, pregunta si cuando se vuelvan a casar, van a firmar la separación de bienes. Sandra invita a salir a Fernando para poder mostrarle que María Lucía está de novia y muy feliz con Damián. Trinidad le cuenta a Zulay la propuesta de Anzola y Zulay la insta a aceptarla. Al mismo tiempo, Anzola se lamenta con Coromoto por la negativa de Trinidad.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Felipe duda del amor genuino de Irene y le pide que se casen. Irene le plantea varias preguntas cuyas respuestas decidirán si se casa con él o no. Pero luego Felipe recibe la inesperada visita de Leonardo, quien le reclama acerca de la verdadera paternidad de Mateo. Tras una acalorada discusión, Leonardo se retira. Virginia le cuenta a Irene acerca de la propuesta matrimonial de Anzola, cuando alguien toca el timbre. Es Rodrigo que viene por María Lucía, pretende invitarla a Europa y darle una vida de lujos. Rebeca cambia la medicación de Agustina y esta última sufre un colapso nervioso del que son testigos Coromoto, Jimena y Adolfo. Adolfo amenaza nuevamente a Rodrigo y lo insta a que frene la reapertura del caso de Miguel Ferrándiz.

programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff get bit by catfish in Southern Oklahoma with YouTuber Nate Williams of Adrenaline Rush Adventures while using the most primitive fishing tactic - hand fishing. Learn from the Chickasaw Nation about the history of this method that has been used by Native Americans for thousands of years.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Sail Kings
programme.desc: Jared's teams up with long time friend and fellow guide, Capt. Greg Dini, to conquer the patch reef.

programme.title: West End Boatworks
programme.desc: The crew heads to Bimini, Bahamas, utilizing the boat's long-range design in the waters that inspired the brand. Along the way, they chase tuna, snorkel beneath the surface, and experience the adventure, freedom, and capability West End was built around.

programme.title: Fred Bear - Father of Bowhunting
programme.desc: Widely considered "the Father of Bowhunting," Bear's legend has only grown with time due to his unmatched skills in the field, as well as his role in creating one of the leading bowhunting companies in the world. No bowhunter has ever influenced the sport as much as Bear did, and it's likely no hunter ever will.

programme.title: Full Strut
programme.desc: Ty has been bow hunting turkey's for quite some time. Every year he tries to focus on getting all of his families tags filled before trying to harvest a gobbler himself. This year was no different but it ended off with a perfect hunt for Ty killing a big mature double bearded eastern gobbler!

Shan Twit's dedication to bowhunting finally pays off in Kentucky when he arrows his first Boone and Crockett buck. Years of hard work, scouting, and persistence culminate in this dream hunt through the rolling hills of the Bluegrass State. Watch as Shan's patience and skill come together for the shot of a lifetime.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: This hunt was years in the making. Michael Hunsucker with Heartland Bowhunter had several years of history with this buck, including an incredible encounter with him over a decoy the year before. Heading into this hunt, we knew exactly what deer we were after, we just had to get back into his core area and make it happen.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: Clayton and Skyler kick off the season by putting in the work—prepping stands, checking setups, and getting everything ready for another fall in the whitetail woods. Clayton spends the early part of the season staying patient, waiting for the right opportunity. As the pre-rut starts to pick up, he finally gets his chance on a good buck, but things don’t go as planned. It’s never an easy thing to experience as a bowhunter, but there’s only one thing you can do—learn from it and get right back after it. Not long after, Clayton finds himself with another opportunity, this time on an absolute MEGA 8 point. When the moment finally comes, he settles in and makes a perfect shot. That’s bowhunting—the highs, the lows, and everything in between.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: The episode starts in New Mexico, where Shawn is hunting with Hunters New Mexico and getting into some exciting elk action. From there, we head north to Montana to join Chandler at Flat Willow Creek Outfitters for a hunt he’ll never forget. After a few days of incredible encounters and some close calls, everything finally comes together. Chandler gets his opportunity, makes a perfect shot, and puts his hands on his first-ever bull elk. His reaction says it all. There’s nothing quite like watching someone experience their first bull, especially after putting in the time and having so many memorable hunts along the way. Two states. Some incredible elk encounters. And one first bull that Chandler will never forget.

programme.title: Midwest Whitetail
programme.desc: On this episode we join Mike Reed and his wife Kathryn as the head north to Saskatchewan for an unforgettable archery black bear hunt. From the remote setting of bear camp to the anticipation of close range encounters, this hunt captures everything that makes a northern bear adventure so unique. Follow along as Mike and Kat share the experience together, take in the sights and sounds of the Canadian wilderness, and put the Hoyt to the test on a classic spring bear hunt.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: If you had a blank check to build the best fishing boat possible, what would you create? Capt. Justin gets his wish, but it doesn’t come quickly or easily.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt. Justin takes a fellow guide on his new boat to see how it measures up. Using only public waypoints on his Humminbird unit, they find exploring to be as much fun as it is fruitful.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Across the country, deer season to many Americans is a rite of passage. For generations, Winchester has been the trusted ammunition choice for hunters…and it’s been a decade since the game-changing Deer Season XP whitetail line was introduced. In this episode, we’ll celebrate the many successes by Team Winchester hunters in the field during whitetail and mule deer firearm seasons across the United States. - GUESTS: Melissa Bachman (Team Winchester) Mark Drury (Team Winchester) Nikki Boxler (Team Winchester) Chris Keefer (Team Winchester) Casey Keefer (Team Winchester) Jason Gilbertson (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The mission of Shoot United is to be a content resource for millions of shooters and a place where people can learn, build confidence and find ways to participate. Through films, educational videos and articles, SU has impacted countless shooters all over the world. In this episode, join Shoot United Ambassadors as they inspire and educate through a series of instructional videos and stories in pistol, self-defense, trap and skeet and sporting clays. - GUESTS: Thea Van Sync (Team Winchester) Callie Farill (Team Winchester) Becky Yackley (Team Winchester) Theo Ribbs (Team Winchester) Jessica Hook (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: Clayton heads into his very first sit of the season in Kansas with a hang and hunt setup, and the results are unforgettable. On opening day, a 10 point buck steps into bow range, and Clayton makes the shot count. This hunt is packed with raw emotion as he reflects on his dad’s recent passing, making the moment even more powerful.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode Slade travels to Kansas to try and bag one of the Midwest's most impressive deer!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode we turkey hunt here in southwest Mississippi with Cragg Fitz from Trained Assassins TV. It's the opening week of turkey season in Mississippi and the birds are gobbling and looking for love. They whip us on opening morning but we stumble upon one that afternoon and make our move and he makes his! You won't want to miss this episode!

Brady Snyder proves why Iowa is legendary for trophy whitetails as he shares his double success from last season. Watch this bow hunting master break down the strategies that led to harvesting two big bucks in his home state. From scouting to shot placement, Brady reveals what it takes to consistently tag wall-hangers in the heartland.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: Taylor hunts a GIANT typical whitetail with her Excalibur while her hunt takes an equally big turn.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Kansas doesn’t give up giants easily. After a tough early-season grind chasing Midwest whitetails, HuntStand’s Will Cooper left Kansas with unfinished business. But the season wasn’t over. In December, he returned to face brutal winds, bitter cold, long sits, and a mature Kansas buck that always seemed to stay one step ahead. What started as another trip to the Midwest quickly became a test of patience, persistence, and just how long you’re willing to stay in the game. Because some hunts come together fast. Others make you earn every second of them.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: There’s nothing quite like November in Iowa! The rut action is absolutely incredible as David Lindsey of The Lindsey Way finds himself surrounded by the kind of whitetail activity we wait all year to experience.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation
programme.desc: “Part of our responsibility as citizens in this country is to make sure we not only take care of these resources but we hand it off to the next generation in better condition that we found it.” -Bob Ziehmer, Senior Director of Conservation for Bass Pro Shops & Cabela's Join Bob in New Mexico as he talks about taking care of our natural resources for future generations. Special thanks to Express UU Bar Ranch

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the remote Turkish mountains, host Dan Cabela looks at how regulated hunting of ibex has helped protect large areas for wildlife, and funds local conservation initiatives.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: The ice is finally broken in Nebraska!! Brent Purvis, pastor of Cascade Hills Church in Columbus, GA goes after his first ever velvet buck. The crew also dove hunts in the morning and cooks up some Timber to Table Dove poppers.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Tyler Jordan hunts one of the biggest bucks on Realtree Farms with his brother Colton. Colton and his Dad Bill, have seen this buck several times over the last few days not he and Tyler make a move hoping to get Colton a shot at this giant Georgia whitetail.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: The crew needed a weather change to get the bucks on their feet before shooting light ended in Nebraska. They got their wish. Highs in the 100's changed to highs in the 60's and sustained 30 MPH winds! Check out Pitts' 5th day hunt for the target buck he's been after all week!

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Tyler Jordan hosts Turkeys For Tomorrow (TFT) hunt sweepstakes winner Troy Martin from Kentucky on a hunt at Realtree Farms. The morning started off good with warmer temperatures and multiple turkeys gobbling on the roost. After setting up in the hardwoods on the edge of a field, a few longbeards pitch down and come straight to the call. It results in a quick hunt on a beautiful morning. To become a member of TFT, and to support its many conservation efforts to ensure we have healthy turkeys populations in the future, click the link below.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Chipper Jones heads down to Harris County, Georgia to hunt with the rest of the Road Trips crew. On day 2 of his hunt, he moves into a ground blind on Realtree Farms. The move proved to be the right one as a buck nicknamed “Triple Threat” stayed consistent on his summer pattern and offered Chipper a 25 yard shot!

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: After a slow opening day with hot, humid temperatures, the focus shifts back to "Big Heavy" on day 2 of bow season. Chipper Jones joins Tyler in camp at Realtree Farms on September 10th to try his luck on a Georgia giant as well. A quick tweak to Tyler's tree stand location proves to be the right move. At 6:30, Tyler spots "Big Heavy' moving into the same orchard that he hunted on opening day! An epic bow hunt ends in celebration for the road trips crew!

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: After a successful opening weekend, the crew heads out to work on controlling the doe population only to have an encounter with a huge 8-pointer. Should Bryan Brown have shot?

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The boys are at the dirty bird in Oklahoma kicking off the second day of bow season. Randy is already tagged out on a dandy of an 8 point we showed you last season in the “Camp Buck episode”. Joe Umphries from Big Tine is in camp and he is trying to close the deal on a buck he had a close call with last season at the Dirty Bird.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy is at home on the Raven planting food plots and trying to get everything on the farm ready for fall.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: It’s still opening week of bow season in Oklahoma and the crew has three tags left to fill.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy and Cody are wrapping things up on the Raven before bow season arrives in Missouri. Planting I-70 the plot where Randy killed one of his biggest Missouri bucks ever last year. Then Randy and Cody attempt to setup a new farm they are calling “The River Farm” they attempt to plant a food plot, bush hog, spray the plot, setup a new Titan blind, and setup a Hooyman dual perimeter fence all in one day before the sun goes down.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Trenton makes a trip to Louisiana to fish with Theophile Bourgeois at the Cajun Vista Lodge. With an early rain delay, they took a tour of the lodge and learned about its long standing family history before hitting the water for some redfish.

programme.desc: Despite the weather, Capt. Josh Calhoon and his wife Anna take a day off to target mangrove snapper before moving into deeper water to search for quality amberjacks.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt. Justin and Florida WaterSports pro Jeff Lange go deep off Panama City Beach to test the limits of a new battery powered reel. The results are surprising.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We join Blake Barnett alongside hunter Jimmy Reynolds as they take part in the 2nd Annual Pierce Dutton Memorial Hunt. This meaningful whitetail hunt is made possible by the great folks at Disabled Outdoorsmen. Jimmy settles in at the G2 Ranch in South Texas, where prime whitetail country and a shared passion for the outdoors set the stage for an unforgettable hunt.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Every year, hunters from across the country flock to various parts of Texas to extend their hunting season. This year, our friends from Struttinbuck did just the same. Matt and Clede make the long drive to Del Rio to hunt South Texas bucks right on the Mexico border.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Explore the fascinating history of exotic species in Texas, tracking how non-native wildlife populations have transformed the Lone Star landscape from early 20th-century introductions to today. Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys’ premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: Local Knowledge

From unforgettable fishing to first-class hospitality, this episode shows why Key West and the Florida Keys are among the world’s premier fishing and vacation destinations.
